title: Opaque forest problem on finding opaque sets for various planar shapes
exact_target: For a given planar convex shape, find the shortest set of curves that intercepts every line passing through it. The curves may be disconnected or lie outside the shape.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 7200053 (AMR-071-0053). CC BY 4.0.
Adrian Dumitrescu, Minghui Jiang and János Pach, Opaque sets (2012 version). Sections 1–2, pp. 1–4.
